notes: Circuit: 5V -> bottom + rail -> orange wire to column 4 -> pushbutton -> column 6 -> Uno pin 2 (teal wire) and 10k pull-down resistor (col 6 to col 9) -> col 9 black wire to bottom - rail -> Uno GND.

Breadboard naming follows the catalogue (bank 't' = rows a-e, bank 'b' = rows f-j); the image draws rows j-f at the top and e-a at the bottom, so the button straddles the centre gap at columns 4 and 6.

Pushbutton: the left pair of legs (column 4, top and bottom) is side 1 and the right pair (column 6) is side 2, so pressing joins 5V (col 4) to pin 2 (col 6). The l/r port names are an arbitrary assignment within each side.
Power-rail hole numbers (bp.2, bp.4, bn.2, bn.9) are approximate, read from the image; only the rail matters electrically.
The black wire from the Uno goes to the second GND header socket in the power header, taken as GND.2.
The 10k resistor is given as value=10000.
No code or other parts are part of the graph.
